title: Expedited Review Track Schedule for Appeals and Grievances Tiers
content:
Of the six Appeals and Grievances tiers, the expedited track belongs to the medical necessity tiers. The schedule sets, per tier:

- *Expedited criteria*: when the case runs on the expedited track ("not applicable" where the tier has none).
- *Expedited track available*: whether the tier has an expedited track.
- *Standard to expedited*: whether a standard case may be moved to the expedited track when the criteria are met.
- *Expedited to standard*: whether an expedited request that does not meet the criteria continues on the standard track.

| Tier | Expedited criteria | Expedited track available | Standard to expedited | Expedited to standard |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Allowable Charge Review | not applicable | no | no | no |
| Beneficiary Grievance | not applicable | no | no | no |
| Claim Factual Reconsideration | not applicable | no | no | no |
| Enrollment Reinstatement Review | not applicable | no | no | no |
| Medical Necessity Reconsideration | an ongoing inpatient stay or a delay seriously jeopardizing life or health | yes | yes | no |
| Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration | an ongoing inpatient stay or a delay seriously jeopardizing life or health | yes | no | yes |

**Distinguishing the two medical necessity tiers on this facet**

| Question | Medical Necessity Reconsideration | Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration |
|---|---|---|
| Can a case that meets the criteria move onto the expedited track? | yes | no |
| Does a request that fails the criteria continue on the standard track? | no | yes |

The four other tiers have no expedited track, so neither movement applies to them.
